title: Mixing: London Town demos by Paul McCartney | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

On 3 March 1977 studio engineer Geoff Emerick made stereo mixes of various demos recorded by Paul McCartney for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town.

McCartney had made the recordings at his Rude Studio in Scotland. Although some of the songs were already being recorded at Abbey Road, McCartney wanted the mixes for future reference.

The songs were ‘Yes Sir, I Will’, ‘Purple Afternoon’ (a working title for ‘London Town’), ‘Twelve Of The Clock’, ‘With A Little Luck’, ‘How Do You Like The Lyrics’, ‘The Pound Is Sinking’, ‘Girls School’, ‘Cafe On The Left Bank’, ‘Famous Groupies’, ‘Love Awake’, ‘Mull Of Kintyre’, ‘Dress Me Up As A Robber’, ‘Down San Francisco Bay’, ‘Winter Rose’, ‘Find A Way’, ‘After The Ball’, ‘Girlfriend’, and ‘Children Children’.
